text:
Marta (CS): heads-up — onboarding for CarePath is showing p95 spikes on /v1/chat (baseline ~720ms -> now ~1350ms). renewal check-in in 4 days. thinking of a targeted mitigation: route short triage/summary requests to compact-6B-int8 with a size-based rule and keep gpu-large for long docs. want to run a small offline QA and a 12h canary.

Diego (Solutions): can we get p50/p95 and avg token length? also a representative prompt so i can run a quick quality delta estimate.

Marta (CS): p50 ~310ms, p95 ~1350ms, avg payload ~140 tokens but many ~400 tokens. prompt sample: "Summarize presenting complaints and list recommended follow-ups for the care team."

Priyanka (SRE): any pattern around KV cache misses or bulk imports?

Marta (CS): yes — spikes align with nightly imports around 03:30 UTC and occasional preview surges midday. routing short requests off the heavy runtime should tighten the tail p95.

Diego (Solutions): rollout suggestion: 1) offline eval on carepath_triage_suite (metrics: entity-F1, ROUGE, hallucination flags); 2) routing rule: prefer compact-6B-int8 when request.tokens <= 700; 3) canary 12% for 12h with auto-rollback if UI feedback rate >1.5% in 30m or automated hallucination >1%; 4) collect flagged examples for customer QA.

Marta (CS): @Dr. Alvarez — can you enable a short feedback toggle for clinicians during the canary (reason: missing follow-up / wrong med / unclear)? we'll auto-rollback if issues exceed thresholds.

Dr. Alvarez (Customer): yes, enable the toggle and please send flagged examples to our QA inbox. auto-rollback ok. clinicians prefer a one-click reason menu.

Priyanka (SRE): provisioning canary infra and wiring rollback. thresholds: feedback_thresh=0.015, eval_window=30m. will also temporarily limit import concurrency in the 03:00-04:00 UTC window.

Diego (Solutions): sample routing snippet (pseudo-yaml):
```yaml
rules:
  - name: compact-short-pref
    match: route.path == "/v1/chat" and request.tokens <= 700
    prefer: compact-6B-int8
    fallback: gpu-large-13B
    canary_percent: 12
    window: 12h
    auto_rollback_on_feedback: true
```

Marta (CS): assigning: @Diego run offline eval + A/B and post artifacts; @Priyanka run canary infra + rollback; @Dr. Alvarez enable feedback toggle. i'll add a short remediation note to the renewal packet.

observability-bot: Canary created (id: canary-8523456789). Observability: https://console.redwood/example/canary/canary-8523456789

Priyanka (SRE): canary live. initial metrics streaming: canary group p95=520ms, baseline group p95=1320ms. quick smoke QA (n=20): phrasing differences 3/20, no entity errors found. feedback widget enabled.

Diego (Solutions): early estimates: routed p95 down ~60% for short requests, projected token-cost reduction ~44% for routed traffic. if offline eval entity-F1 delta <1.5% and hallucination <0.8% recommend ramp to 50% over 24h.

Dr. Alvarez (Customer): feedback toggle live. clinicians flagged 2 items (style) so far and submitted short reasons. will escalate immediately if any incorrect medication or missing critical follow-up.

Priyanka (SRE): auto-rollback not triggered. feedback rate 0.7% over first 4h. streaming alerts to #cs-renewals.

Diego (Solutions): offline eval finished: entity-F1 delta -0.5%, ROUGE drop 0.9, automated hallucination 0.2%. artifacts uploaded to renewal folder.

Marta (CS): renewal brief note: "Proactive perf mitigation executed: compact-6B-int8 canary reduced p95 for routed short traffic by ~60% with projected token-cost savings ~44%; quality within guardrails. recommended ramp plan attached." will include flagged examples in the deck.

Dr. Alvarez (Customer): this looks good — thanks for moving quickly and for the rollback safeguards. keep the clinicians' toggle on during the ramp.

Priyanka (SRE): plan: ramp to 50% in 12h if metrics remain stable; keep auto-rollback and import concurrency caps in place. will update thread with ramp metrics. :rocket:
